description: Chest Monster default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/chest_monster-character-sheet.png: the six palette chips (intake.json swatches: box tan 210,154,99 / lid brown 71,40,17 / eye orange 253,144,56 / feet red-orange 253,97,44 / crystal blue 73,79,253 / magic pink 252,184,170) plus direct samples of the drawn surfaces (service venv PIL; front view unless noted; crystal facet tones = 5-means of the big cluster's blue pixels). GLOW (drawn on the sheet): the crystals, the toes and the magic smoke (+ its spark flecks) only; tiers stay under the 2.0 cap. Translucent regions carry 'alpha' (Col alpha = glTF COLOR_0.a; the fx material is alphaMode BLEND, double-sided); material.alpha multiplies every translucent region.
